host: PWRunner | Swift; inside the XPC bundle; launchd: XPC service lookup, or a Mach service for BYOXPC; no; none, by the invariance rule; actor-form token custody copies, compares and erases bytes without a sandbox call; one reservation and at most one specimen; unused reservation expiry or abandonment retires the host; terminal reply flush delay 50 milliseconds is best effort All authorized connections share one locked reservation slot. Only the connection holding its grant can consume it, before specimen decoding. Stale expiry or disconnect cannot retire an executing owner; client loss after submission never permits replay.
T3: effect-free NSXPC reservation, then one runReservedSpecimen call and its reply |

worker: pw-probe-runner | C; inside the XPC bundle; the host; yes; applies the specimen policy to itself; sandbox_compile_string, params, sandbox_apply; sandbox_extension_consume and sandbox_extension_release; sandbox_extension_issue_file in an actor; one specimen in the single-worker form, or one actor of an actor-form specimen; one application (none for an unapplied actor) and all of its ordered visits; parked between visits; terminal publication exits without host permission

T5: posix_spawn; fd 0 policy pipe, fd 3 shared region, fd 4 ready pipe; optional fd 5 transient token channel | Policy delivery uses nonblocking writes under one absolute monotonic deadline (the worker_policy_transfer limit) beginning after spawn. Expiry closes input and enters cleanup before readiness or sentinel polling. The pipe carries no framing: the host writes the submission's byte count into the shared header before spawn, and the worker at EOF publishes the count it read and refuses a different length before compiling.
T5 posix_spawn; fds 0, 3, 4; optional 5

T15: actor form: posix_spawn with an empty environment, stdin policy pipe, null stdout/stderr and CLOEXEC_DEFAULT; fd 5 the actor's own authority region; activation ordinal and shared lifetime cutoff in the evidence header | One region per actor, mapped by the host before launch and by that actor before application; a validator or another actor never maps it. Setup allowance 10,000 milliseconds; lifetime cutoff 180,000 milliseconds.
